ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The keystone arch is an ancient architectural feature. It is composed of congruent isosceles trapezoids fitted together along the non-parallel sides, as shown. The bottom sides of the two end trapezoids are horizontal. In an arch made with $ 9$ trapezoids, let $ x$ be the angle measure in degrees of the larger interior angle of the trapezoid. What is $ x$?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a semicircular arch-shaped structure, made by sequentially piecing together 9 congruent isosceles trapezoid blocks. Adjacent trapezoids are joined along the non-parallel sides, the bottom sides at the left and right ends are both located on the same horizontal line, and the entire arch forms a half circle from the left end to the right end. Reasoning: Let δ represent the turning angle between the two non-parallel sides of one trapezoid, that is, the angle by which the direction changes when going from one block to the next. 9 congruent trapezoids together form a semicircular arch, so the total turning angle is 180°, therefore 9δ = 180°, giving δ = 20°. In an isosceles trapezoid, the larger interior angle is x, and the smaller interior angle is 180° - x. The turning angle between the two non-parallel sides equals x - (180° - x) = 2x - 180°. Thus 2x - 180 = 20, solving gives 2x = 200, so x = 100.

method.method_draft: Inspect the diagram first: the arch is a chain of congruent trapezoidal blocks joined along their non-parallel sides, and the two exposed end sides at the bottom are horizontal on opposite ends of the arch. Let δ be the angle between the two non-parallel sides of one trapezoid, equivalently the amount the direction of the joint line turns from one block to the next. Since there are 9 congruent trapezoids and the chain makes a half-turn from the left horizontal end side to the right horizontal end side, 9δ = 180°, so δ = 20°. In an isosceles trapezoid whose larger angle is x, the smaller angle is 180° - x, and the angle between the non-parallel sides is x - (180° - x) = 2x - 180°. Set 2x - 180 = 20 and solve to get x = 100.

推理：令 δ 表示一个梯形两条非平行边之间的转角，也就是从一个块到下一个块时方向改变的角度。9 个全等梯形共同形成一个半圆拱，所以总转角是 180°，因此 9δ = 180°，得到 δ = 20°。在等腰梯形中，较大的内角为 x，较小的内角为 180° - x。两条非平行边之间的转角等于 x - (180° - x) = 2x - 180°。于是 2x - 180 = 20，解得 2x = 200，所以 x = 100。

method.method_draft: Inspect the diagram first: the trapezoids form a symmetric keystone-style half-arch, with the non-parallel sides acting like equal radial seams and the two bottom end seams horizontal. Extend the non-parallel sides of the trapezoids mentally; the 9 congruent blocks correspond to 9 equal wedge angles filling a straight angle, so each wedge angle is 180°/9 = 20°. For one isosceles trapezoid, extending its legs until they meet forms an isosceles triangle with apex angle 20°. The base angles of that triangle are (180° - 20°)/2 = 80°. Because the trapezoid bases are parallel, the larger trapezoid angle is supplementary to 80°, giving x = 100°.

图像描述：图中是一座对称的拱形结构，由 9 个全等的等腰梯形石块组成。相邻梯形沿非平行边相接，整体形成半圆拱的形状；左右两端的梯形底边落在同一条水平线上。

推理：按照图形结构，将每个梯形的两条非平行边向内延长，它们对应为从同一中心发出的径向分隔线。9 个全等梯形对应 9 个相等的楔形角，并且这些楔形角正好填满一个平角，即 180°。所以每个楔形角为 180° ÷ 9 = 20°。

对任意一个等腰梯形，把它的两条腰延长到相交，会形成一个顶角为 20° 的等腰三角形。该等腰三角形的两个底角相等，每个为 (180° - 20°) ÷ 2 = 80°。

因为梯形的两条底边平行，所以梯形中较大的内角与这个 80° 角互为补角。因此 x = 180° - 80° = 100°。
